verdict.rationale:
Highnote docs explicitly support issuing virtual/single-use cards via API with spend rules configurable on MCC, dollar amount, and authorization count, plus velocity controls and per-card/agent workflow issuance that auto-closes after use — directly matching one-purchase, one-merchant, exact-amount scoping. The agentic-commerce page reinforces per-agent/workflow card issuance with automatic closure and rule enforcement at authorization time before funds move.

missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of true 'single-use' enforcement behavior in production, and no explicit doc example showing a card scoped to exactly one merchant AND one exact amount combined in a single rule.
